description.value: Take Five Cafe is a Metro Vancouver coffee franchise that has been operating since 2003, serving specialty Arabica espresso drinks alongside Italian-inspired savouries such as panini and wraps, freshly baked pastries, and seasonal specialty drinks. The café has both indoor and outdoor seating and operates a loyalty rewards program. It is one of several franchise locations across the region, including New Westminster, Surrey, Port Coquitlam, North Vancouver, Vancouver, and Burnaby.
